import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CanonicalDifferentials
import Mathlib.FieldTheory.SeparablyGenerated
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Kaehler.Polynomial
import Mathlib.RingTheory.AlgebraicIndependent.RankAndCardinality

/-!
# Separating rational functions on smooth curves

Over a perfect field, the function field of a smooth integral curve is finite
and separable over the subfield generated by a single transcendental function.
The proof combines the rank-one differential calculation with a separating
transcendence basis. It does not select a preferred function or construct its
associated morphism to the projective line.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra

/-- The ground-field function-field extension of a smooth integral curve is
essentially of finite type. -/
theorem essFiniteType_curveFunctionField
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsIntegral X.left] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] :
    Algebra.EssFiniteType k X.left.functionField := by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hηV, hsm⟩ :=
    smoothCurve_exists_standardSmooth_affineOpen X (genericPoint X.left)
  haveI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨genericPoint X.left, hηV⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, V) := (X.left.overAlgebraMap k V).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 k Γ(X.left, V) := hsm.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k Γ(X.left, V) := hsm.isStandardSmooth.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsFractionRing Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X.left V hV
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext r
    change (X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X.left) trivial).hom
      (X.left.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ r) =
        (X.left.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint X.left) _).hom
          (X.left.overAlgebraMap k V r)
    have hres := X.left.presheaf.germ_res_apply
      (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)) (genericPoint X.left) hηV
      (X.left.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ r)
    rw [X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op r] at hres
    exact hres.symm
  haveI : Algebra.EssFiniteType Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization _ (nonZeroDivisors Γ(X.left, V))
  exact Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k Γ(X.left, V) X.left.functionField

private theorem rank_kaehler_eq_of_algEquiv
    {k B C : Type u} [CommRing k] [Field B] [Field C]
    [Algebra k B] [Algebra k C] (e : B ≃ₐ[k] C) :
    Module.rank B (Ω[B⁄k]) = Module.rank C (Ω[C⁄k]) := by
  letI : Algebra B C := e.toAlgHom.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower k B C := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x =>
    (e.commutes x).symm
  haveI : Algebra.FormallyEtale B C := by
    have e' : B ≃ₐ[B] C := AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId B C) e.bijective
    exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_equiv e'
  rw [← (KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k B C).rank_eq,
    Module.rank_baseChange, Cardinal.lift_id]

/-- Over a perfect field, the differential rank of an essentially finite type
field extension is its transcendence degree. -/
theorem rank_kaehlerDifferential_eq_trdeg_of_perfectField
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [PerfectField k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K] :
    Module.rank K (Ω[K⁄k]) = Algebra.trdeg k K := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, H⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis_and_isSeparable_of_perfectField k K
  let F : IntermediateField k K := IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set K)
  haveI : Algebra.IsSeparable F K := H
  haveI : Algebra.FormallyEtale F K := Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable F K
  have h1 : Module.rank K (Ω[K⁄k]) = Module.rank F (Ω[F⁄k]) := by
    rw [← (KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k F K).rank_eq,
      Module.rank_baseChange, Cardinal.lift_id]
  have e : FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k) ≃ₐ[k] F := by
    change FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k) ≃ₐ[k]
      IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set K)
    have hset : (s : Set K) = Set.range ((↑) : {x // x ∈ s} → K) :=
      (Subtype.range_coe).symm
    rw [hset]
    exact hs.1.aevalEquivField
  have h2 : Module.rank F (Ω[F⁄k]) =
      Module.rank (FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k))
        (Ω[FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k)⁄k]) :=
    (rank_kaehler_eq_of_algEquiv e).symm
  have h3 : Module.rank (FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k))
      (Ω[FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k)⁄k]) =
        Cardinal.mk {x // x ∈ s} := by
    haveI : IsLocalizedModule (nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k))
        (KaehlerDifferential.map k k (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k)
          (FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k))) :=
      KaehlerDifferential.isLocalizedModule_map k (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k)
        (FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k))
        (nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k))
    let b : Module.Basis {x // x ∈ s} (FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k))
        (Ω[FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k)⁄k]) :=
      (KaehlerDifferential.mvPolynomialBasis k {x // x ∈ s}).ofIsLocalizedModule
        (FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k))
        (nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k))
        (KaehlerDifferential.map k k (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k)
          (FractionRing (MvPolynomial {x // x ∈ s} k)))
    exact b.mk_eq_rank''.symm
  rw [h1, h2, h3, hs.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg]

/-- The function field of a smooth integral curve over a perfect field has
transcendence degree one. -/
theorem trdeg_curveFunctionField_eq_one
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [PerfectField k]
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] :
    Algebra.trdeg k X.left.functionField = 1 := by
  letI := essFiniteType_curveFunctionField X
  rw [← rank_kaehlerDifferential_eq_trdeg_of_perfectField k X.left.functionField]
  exact rank_curveRationalDifferentials_eq_one X

/-- A smooth integral curve over a perfect field has a separating rational
function: its function field is finite separable over the generated rational
subfield. The existential witness is not a preferred coordinate. -/
theorem exists_separating_curveFunctionField
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [PerfectField k]
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] :
    ∃ f : X.left.functionField, Transcendental k f ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k {f}) X.left.functionField ∧
      Module.Finite (IntermediateField.adjoin k {f}) X.left.functionField := by
  classical
  letI := essFiniteType_curveFunctionField X
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsep⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis_and_isSeparable_of_perfectField
    k X.left.functionField
  have hcard : s.card = 1 := by
    have h := hs.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg
    rw [trdeg_curveFunctionField_eq_one X] at h
    simpa using h
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
  refine ⟨f, hs.1.transcendental ⟨f, by simp⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hset : (↑({f} : Finset X.left.functionField) : Set _) = {f} := by simp
    rw [← hset]
    exact hsep
  · let F : IntermediateField k X.left.functionField := IntermediateField.adjoin k {f}
    haveI : Algebra.EssFiniteType F X.left.functionField :=
      Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_comp k F X.left.functionField
    haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F X.left.functionField := by
      change Algebra.IsAlgebraic (IntermediateField.adjoin k
        ({f} : Set X.left.functionField)) X.left.functionField
      have hset : (↑({f} : Finset X.left.functionField) : Set _) = {f} := by simp
      have hrange : Set.range ((↑) : {x // x ∈ ({f} : Finset X.left.functionField)} →
          X.left.functionField) = (↑({f} : Finset X.left.functionField) : Set _) :=
        Subtype.range_coe
      have halg := hs.isAlgebraic_field
      rw [hrange] at halg
      rw [← hset]
      exact halg
    simpa [F] using (Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
      (F := F) (E := X.left.functionField))

end
end Hartshorne
